failed_candidates: <plan>We will move into the area near the existing table, then use the wooden pickaxe to gather wood, stone and any available minerals. With these resources we can craft a stone pickaxe and stone sword. Next, we will mine iron ore and coal, place a furnace, smelt iron, and craft iron tools. Meanwhile we will plant and eat plants, collect drinks from water, defeat the visible skeleton, and collect arrows. Once all achievements are satisfied we will collect a diamond, and finally perform a Sleep action to wake up. This sequence prioritizes gathering required materials first, then crafting, combat, and finally other achievements. <\/plan> Place Table

<plan>1. Place Plant to obtain Place Plant achievement.  
2. Place Table to obtain Place Table achievement.  
3. Do on nearby grass to collect Wood (Collect Wood).  
4. Use Make Wood Sword with table and collected wood to obtain Make Wood Sword achievement.  
5. Navigate to the cow (four steps northwest) and Do on it to Eat Cow.  
6. Do on the water one step south to collect Drink (Collect Drink).  
7. Navigate to the coal source (seven steps southwest) and Do on it to collect Coal (Collect Coal).  
8. Locate and mine a stone block with the wood pickaxe (Do on stone) to obtain Collect Stone.  
9. Place a Stone block in front (Place Stone) to obtain Place Stone.  
10. Use the stone pickaxe by crafting it with Make Stone Pickaxe and then attack the skeleton (Do on skeleton) to defeat Skeleton (Defeat Skeleton).  
11. Craft an iron pickaxe with Make Iron Pickaxe (requires furnace, coal, iron, wood).  
12. Craft an iron sword with Make Iron Sword.  
13. Use the iron sword to defeat a zombie, if encountered, to achieve Defeat Zombie.  
14. Use the iron pickaxe to mine iron ore (Collect Iron).  
15. Construct a furnace (Place Furnace).  
16. Smelt iron and coal as needed.  
17. Continue exploring until a diamond is found and collected (Collect Diamond).  
18. Whenever energy drops below maximum, Sleep to trigger Wake Up achievement.<plan>
